label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
**To my friends, neighbours, the Little Acorns families, and everyone who's been messaging**

Hi everyone,

I'm writing one letter because my phone hasn't stopped since Saturday night. I've read every message, even the ones I haven't answered, and I've cried at nearly all of them. I'm so tired, and I'm sorry I can't reply to each of you. This is me trying to answer everyone at once. Please feel free to forward it to anyone who's been asking.

**First, I'm okay.** Truly. I'm safe, I'm not hurt, and I'm staying with my sister for now. Marmalade is okay too. She's a bit offended by the whole thing, but she's fine.

**What happened (the short version)**

On Saturday 7 November, at about 11:40pm, a fire started in one of the ground floor flats at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. It wasn't my flat; I'm up on the second floor. There are 14 flats in our building and **everyone got out.** Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home the same night. When I think about how much worse it could have been, that's the part I hold onto.

The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess or say more than that. Please don't pass on any rumours about whose fault it was. My neighbours have been through enough.

The fire didn't reach my flat, but the smoke and water did. Everything is soaked and black, and the ceiling in the lounge came down. The landlord says nobody will be allowed back in for at least six weeks, and honestly I don't know how much of what's in there can be saved.

I want to say thank you to Uncle Faizel, our neighbour, who went down our whole floor banging on every door in his vest and slippers. That's how I woke up. I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and nothing else and ran. Marmalade then hid under a car for two hours and I sat on the pavement calling her. Furniture can be replaced. She can't. So I'm counting myself lucky.

**What I actually need**

I really hate asking for help. I'm much better at being the one handing out tissues and plasters. But Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it, so here goes:

1. **Help with a deposit for a new place.** This is the big one. I can't stay at my sister's forever (sorry sis) and I can't go home for at least six weeks, probably longer. Finding a new place means a deposit and first month's rent at once, and that's where I'm stuck.
2. **School shoes and work clothes.** Shoes in a **size 6**, clothes in a **size 34**. Practical stuff I can wear to sit on tiny chairs, kneel on the carpet and get paint on.
3. **A laptop, if anyone has an old one that still works.** All my lesson planning was on mine. It doesn't need to be fancy, it just needs to turn on and open a document. If you have one sitting in a cupboard, please message Zinhle on [Zinhle's number] and she'll sort it out with you.

**What I don't need (please!)**

- **More clothes in general.** You have all been so generous that I already have way more than I can use. I'll pass the extras on to the other people from the building who lost things, so nothing will go to waste. But please don't send more.
- **Food.** My sister's freezer is completely full. I promise I'm eating.

I know it feels better to give something you can hold, and I love you for it. But the most helpful thing right now really is the list above.

**The fundraiser, and the fake one**

My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me. This is the **only** real one:

👉 **backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is R25 000, and when I checked this morning it was already at R11 400. I can't really believe that. Thank you to everyone who has given, shared it, or just sent a kind message. I feel weird about it, I'm not going to pretend I don't, but I'm also so grateful.

⚠️ **PLEASE READ THIS PART** ⚠️

There is a **fake** fundraiser going around called **"Thandi Fire Relief"** on another site, and there's also a **WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money into a Capitec account.** **That is NOT me.** I didn't make it, I don't know who did, and the money does not come to me. I've reported it.

So, to be clear:

- The only real fundraiser is the BackaBuddy link above.
- **I will never ask you to EFT money into a personal bank account over WhatsApp.** Neither will Zinhle.
- If someone messages you asking for money "for Thandi" in any other way, please don't send anything, and please let them know it's a scam.

It makes me sick that someone would use something like this to steal from kind people, so please help me spread the word. If you forward this letter, that's already a big help.

**For the Little Acorns families**

To my Ladybirds parents: **the concert on 27 November is still happening.** Please don't worry.

I did have all the concert things at home with me to laminate, and they're gone. That's the 22 crowns and the kids' handprint banner. I'm not going to lie, that one hurt a bit. But the Ladybirds **will** have crowns on the night, I promise. We might just be making some of them again together, and honestly, they'll probably enjoy that more.

I'm back at school on Wednesday. I have one big favour to ask: **please don't make a big thing of it in front of the kids.** They're four and five, and I don't want them scared or worried about their teacher. I'd rather just walk in, say good morning, and have a normal day of glue sticks and snack time and someone needing the toilet at exactly the wrong moment. That normal day is honestly what I need most. If your child has heard something and asks questions, it's completely fine to tell them that there was a fire at Miss Thandi's building, everyone is safe, and her cat is safe too. That's all they need to know.

And to the mom who left a bag of clothes on my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking: I know who you are, and thank you. You have no idea what that did for me that morning.

**A small request**

I'm going to be slow to reply to comments and messages for a while. Please don't be offended if I don't answer your DM. It's not that I don't care, I promise. I'm just running on very little sleep and a lot of paperwork, and some days I don't have the words yet. I'm reading everything, even when I go quiet.

**Thank you**

I don't really know how to end this except to say thank you. People have been amazing: friends, neighbours, parents, people I've never even met who got this forwarded from someone's aunt's group chat. I've been crying at every message, but they're mostly good tears.

I lost a lot of stuff on Saturday. I didn't lose anyone, and I didn't lose Marmalade. I'm starting to understand that stuff really is just stuff.

With so much love, and a very grumpy cat on my lap,

**Thandi**

---

*If you'd like to help, the only real fundraiser is backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court. I will never ask for money via WhatsApp or EFT to a personal account. Please forward this to anyone who might need to see it.*

---

A few notes:
- I left out your flat number and that your sister lives in Rondebosch. This will be forwarded to strangers, and with a scammer already using your name, it's safer not to say exactly where you're staying. Add Rondebosch back if you want.
- You'll need to put Zinhle's real number (or whatever contact you prefer) where it says [Zinhle's number] so people know where to send laptops. Check with her first, since this will reach a lot of people.
- Today is Wednesday the 11th. If you meant *next* Wednesday, change it to "Wednesday 18 November" so parents aren't confused.
